newsitem.title: USA: Xpedite investor group has 9.16 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Xpedite investor group has 9.16 pct stake.

text.p: An investor group that has proposed a $22.50 a share cash takeover of Xpedite Systems Inc. said Tuesday that it already has 844,297 of the company's common shares, or 9.16 percent of the total.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commssion, the group, which includes Xpedite Chief Executive Officer Roy Anderson and other company executives, said it is also considering making an offer for the company's European affiliates, Xpedite Systems Ltd. and Xpedite Systems GmbH.

Under its Feb. 7 takeover proposal, which is conditioned upon the approval of board and will expire on March 7 unless there is a definitive agreement, the group said the Eatontown, N.J. company would become privately owned by its members and two other entities that would help fund the transaction, UBS Partners and Fenway Partners Inc.
It said it also anticipated getting financing for the deal from Union Bank of Switzerland.
The Xpedite board, without Anderson's participation, has appointed a special committee of Philip Campbell and Robert Chefitz to consider "strategic alternatives," it said.
